name: Tribal Trouble Mobile
storyline: A longship of Vikings runs aground on a sunny tropical island. The natives who live there have no plans to share it. Lead the Vikings through 14 islands of their campaign, then switch sides and tell the Natives' story across 7 more, as both tribes gather wood, rock and iron, arm their warriors and call on their chieftains' magic to drive the other off the island.
summary: Tribal Trouble Mobile is a remake for Android of Tribal Trouble, the 2005 cartoon real-time strategy game by Oddlabs, made with the original creator's permission. A longship of Vikings has run aground on a tropical island, and the natives who live there have no plans to share it. Gather wood, rock and iron, build quarters and an armory, arm your warriors with rock, iron or a chicken, and lead your chieftain's magic into battle. Two story campaigns (14 Viking islands, then 7 for the Natives), offline games against the computer on random islands, and online battles for up to 6 players with ranks. Free, no ads.
